items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I said, Ms. Plenty, I'd be glad to work with Octavia. Octavia's a nice fellow.

ctx.x: She's not going to let you do that. No, man, she's hard to get along. Like I told Ms. Plenty, I said, Ms. Plenty, I'd be glad to work with Octavia. Octavia's a nice fellow. Well, that is not Octavia, it's that woman's so much help. She's helped, man, and she keep that job. She keep that job. No good nothing at all, nothing like that, man. A woman will kill you. She take your honor. Why you think she could get a white band? Don't you know she'd have a white band there? She can't get any. She like, like Louis…
